sections.text:
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 560. Success value 100. 10x physical damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Abstraction for 40 seconds with a success value of 80.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 120. Applies Beguilement for 40 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Removes 40 Cost.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge by 30.
-Target: all allies. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Overcast for 60 seconds ([Special] increases max HP by 100%; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; increases all elemental defense by 60; recovers 50 Cost. After the effect ends, Time Extend activates and extends the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to yourself by 60 seconds for one time only.).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 15000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Recovers 50 Cost.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 15000
